newsitem.title: USA: AMBAC qualifies 11 muni bond issues for insurance.
newsitem.headline: AMBAC qualifies 11 muni bond issues for insurance.

text.p: AMBAC Indemnity Corp said on Wednesday that it qualified for bond insurance the following 11 issues scheduled for competitive sale:
--Santa Rosa High School District, Calif., $18.2 million GOs.
--Readington Township, N.J., General Improvment bonds, $4.406 million.
--Albany City School District, N.Y., $13.975 million GOs.
--Columbia County, N.Y., Public Improvement bonds, $6.544 million.
--Perry Central School District, N.Y., $1.525 million GOs.
--Aiken County Cons School District, S.C., $9.6 million.
--Faulkey Gully MUD, Texas, Unlimited Tax bonds, $2.52 million.
